verdict.rationale: The only evidence of snoozing is a community note that snoozed emails beyond the 90-day free-plan window still 'arrive in the inbox'. That implies Shortwave has its own snooze-and-resurface behavior, but no first-party doc describes it. Nothing shows conditional follow-up reminders that resurface a thread when nobody replies; scheduled send (outgoing mail at a future time) is a different capability and earns no credit here. missing for 10: first-party snooze documentation, follow-up reminders triggered by no reply, hands-on corroboration of resurfacing behavior.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: snoozed emails past that window won't show up in search results (though they still arrive in the inbox)
